findings.result: Both original ground shaders receive the same TOWN chunk/three insert operations and uniform objects inside applyIsland. Pinned insert checks throw if the expected shader site disappears.

main calls applyIsland before createStation; groundMaterial is island.transition.material. blendStationGround copies its updated fragment and shallow-copies uniform records. uStationCutout remains independently zero. Existing stationGrass semantic mask, EqualDepth, derivative-before-clipping ordering and transparent edgeAlpha are unchanged.

Ground injection changes meadow floor tint and its flower-color wash only, before unchanged scree/beach/pebble/rock/town-mask compositing. No procedural grass/flower mesh code is inserted in terrain fragment. Core station pavement guard remains unchanged. Actual RGB outside grass-dominant surfaces still depends on original material mixture, not a binary biome exclusion.

Pinned upstream Shell constructor stores this.meadow. Wrapper reads this.meadow.wbTownUniforms per material creation and returns original material if absent; it no longer closes over the first look uniform bundle. Prototype installed once via wbTownMaterial. Runtime/other agent owns cross-look CPU validation.

limitations: No new shader compilation, GPU readback, full CPU scene rebuild or image assessment here.
No assertion that visual seam is fixed until root real GPU check.
Repeated applyIsland on the same already-patched island was not tested; normal current main adopts each island once.
